meta.name: Awe
meta.description: The feeling of being small in the best possible way. Awe starts you grounded and present, then lifts the ceiling — expanding up and out, brighter and vaster, until it crests at the edge of something too large to name. For a moment the boundaries thin and everything seems to connect. Then it eases you down into the warm afterglow of wonder, the world left a little bigger than you found it.
